newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Shell Nigeria hands out hundreds of scholarships.
newsitem.headline: Shell Nigeria hands out hundreds of scholarships.

text.p: Royal Dutch Shell's Nigerian unit, which has been under fire over its operations in the West African nation, has awarded 560 scholarships to the best Nigerian university students, the News Agency of Nigeria reported on Wednesday.
More than 400 of the winners are from the Niger Delta in the southeast, where Shell pumps most of Nigeria's crude oil.
The company has faced a barrage of criticism for allegedly causing damage to the environment in its oil mining activities and not providing social amenities in areas where it operates.
Shell said earlier this week that it would spend more than two billion naira this year on community projects in the oil areas.
